# Example Service

## Setup

Install dependencies before development.

```sh
npm install
```

## Run

Run the service locally.

```sh
npm run start
```

## Testing

Run the automated tests before handoff.

```sh
npm test
```

## Environment

Configure environment values from the example file.

## Deployment

Release through the documented deployment workflow.

## Security

Report security concerns privately.

## Support

Contact the maintainers for support.

## Architecture

The HTTP service uses a simple layered architecture.

## Limitations

Known limitations are documented before production use.
